summary: EF 发文列出 EIP-8037 和 EIP-8038 会打破的 8 条合约不变量，并给出自查仓库，Glamsterdam 的 Hoodi 分叉在问题解决前不排期。Nethermind 用 frame transaction 跑通一个自付 gas 的隐私池，提款约 67.9 万 gas，但证明验证超过了验证 gas 上限。EF 介绍 Hegotá 候选的交易断言，以及 I* 的 Partitioned Binary Tree 状态迁移。

items.topic: EIP-8037/8038：会被打破的 8 条不变量
items.title: EF Blog：EIP-8037/EIP-8038 Glamsterdam
items.note: 发布（Marius van der Wijden 署名）。Glamsterdam 测试期间，ChainSecurity 发现一些项目依赖的不变量会被 EIP-8037（状态创建涨价）和 EIP-8038（状态访问调价）打破，因为两者改变了部分操作的收费和状态收费方式。ACD 因此推迟硬分叉流程，问题解决前不分叉 Hoodi；Hegotá 的工作不受影响，全力并行。
items.title_en: EF Blog: EIP-8037/EIP-8038 Glamsterdam
items.note_en: Published under Marius van der Wijden's name. During Glamsterdam testing, ChainSecurity found that invariants some projects rely on will be broken by EIP-8037 (higher state creation cost) and EIP-8038 (repriced state access), because both change how certain operations and state are charged. ACD has therefore paused the hard fork process and will not fork Hoodi until this is resolved. Hegotá work is unaffected and continues at full speed in parallel.

items.topic: Frame Transaction 上的隐私池：能做什么、还差什么
items.title: ethresear.ch：基于 frame transaction 的隐私池
items.note: 20:00 发布（Nethermind 的 Daniil Ankushin，测量由 Manuel Arto 完成）。在 frame transaction 上，隐私池自己支付 gas，私密提款不需要中继者。他们在当前 Nethermind master 上跑了一个真实的 BN254 Groth16 池（soispoke 的 minimal-shielded-pool）：一次提款 679,322 gas。提款时池合约是发送方，它的 VERIFY 代码检查 zk 证明并批准执行和付款，用户不需要有余额的账户，也不出现在交易里。配合 EIP-8250 keyed nonce，可以从同一个池地址并发多笔提款。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: a privacy pool on frame transactions
items.note_en: Posted at 20:00 by Daniil Ankushin of Nethermind, with measurements by Manuel Arto. On frame transactions the privacy pool pays its own gas, so private withdrawals need no relayer. They ran a real BN254 Groth16 pool (soispoke's minimal-shielded-pool) on current Nethermind master: one withdrawal costs 679,322 gas. During a withdrawal the pool contract is the sender, its VERIFY code checks the zk proof and approves execution and payment, and the user needs no funded account and does not appear in the transaction. With EIP-8250 keyed nonces, several withdrawals can run concurrently from the same pool address.
items.topic_en: A privacy pool on Frame Transaction: what works and what is still missing

items.note_en: 06:04. User interviews keep coming back to people not being sure what they are signing. items.topic: 交易断言与 PBT 状态迁移
items.title: EF：I* 准备在不停机的情况下改造状态结构
items.note: 08:05。Partitioned Binary Tree（PBT）会缩小状态证明，让钱包能验证而不是信任，并为状态过期铺路。EIPs PR #12633：EIP-8347 规定激活时的就绪与迟到迁移 16:58 提交，处理节点在激活块到来时 PBT 尚未就绪的情况（应返回 SYNCING 而不是判块无效）。
items.title_en: EF: I* plans to rebuild the state structure without downtime
items.note_en: 08:05. A Partitioned Binary Tree (PBT) shrinks state proofs so that wallets can verify instead of trusting, and paves the way for state expiry. EIPs PR #12633: EIP-8347 specifies readiness at activation and late migration, opened at 16:58, covering nodes whose PBT is not ready when the activation block arrives (they should return SYNCING rather than mark the block invalid).
items.topic_en: Transaction assertions and the PBT state migration

summary_en: The EF published a list of 8 contract invariants that EIP-8037 and EIP-8038 will break, along with a self-check repository, and the Glamsterdam fork on Hoodi will not be scheduled until this is resolved. Nethermind ran a privacy pool that pays its own gas on frame transactions; a withdrawal costs about 679k gas, but proof verification exceeds the validation gas limit. The EF also explained transaction assertions, a Hegotá candidate, and the Partitioned Binary Tree state migration planned for I*.
